item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact
The `/bolt/async/upload-url` and `/bolt/async/embed` endpoints validated only the **submitted** URL before fetching it server-side, but the fetch then **followed redirects to destinations that were never re-validated**. This allowed an authenticated user to bypass the S

item.title: CVE-2026-77379: Bolt: Information disclosure through unfiltered public relation API endpoint
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact
A missing access-control filter in the public Relation API allowed unauthenticated users to discover metadata about unpublished, draft, and viewless content through REST and GraphQL endpoints.
### Patches
This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-77377: Bolt: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in URL-upload and embed endpoints
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact
Two authenticated backend endpoints fetched a user-supplied URL server-side with no protection against internal targets.
### Patches
This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-77376: Bolt: Open redirect enables post-authentication redirection to arbitrary domains
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact
Open redirect vulnerabilities in LoginFormAuthenticator allow attackers to redirect users to attacker-controlled domains after login success or login failure, enabling phishing attacks and potential token theft.
### Patches
This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.
